dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with minimal pixel radius at the vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, measured at approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal plane.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Narrow profile with a base-to-height ratio of approximately 1:3.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius curve forming a smooth, low-convexity arc across the frontal-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short length-to-width ratio due to frontal foreshortening, characterized by a thick pixel profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 150 degrees visible at the medial-dorsal junction where the melon meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Artificial luminescent highlights on the rostrum and dorsal ridge with a non-biological cyan-green color palette.
